tool.verification: Matches publisher GitHub asset digest and HTTPS-fetched SHA256SUMS; GPG signature not verified; no global install.

scope: Private local repository and generated text only; all retention operations are dry runs. Snapshot-reference and encrypted-pack hashes unchanged across selection/previews.
limits: No actual policy deletion/prune, remote backend, personal repository, corruption, concurrent writer, partial backup, calendar retention or tied timestamp qualification.
Generated passwords and encrypted repository stay in ignored work; no credential value retained in public records.
